title: Joining Riverside Library
sourceNotes: Naskah dan audio orisinal tim Success IELTS (disintesis lewat text-to-speech), tidak diambil dari buku atau tes resmi manapun. Lihat docs/DECISIONS.md untuk catatan soal sumber audio.

script.speaker: Receptionist
script.text: Good morning, Riverside Public Library. How can I help you?

script.speaker: Caller
script.text: Hi there. I'd like to join the library. What do I need to do?

script.speaker: Receptionist
script.text: Sure, I can help with that right now. Could I start with your full name?

script.speaker: Caller
script.text: Yes, it's Marcus Webb. That's spelled W, E, B, B.

script.speaker: Receptionist
script.text: Thank you. And what's your home address?

script.speaker: Caller
script.text: I live at 42 Elm Street, in Greenfield.

script.speaker: Receptionist
script.text: Is that the area just outside the city centre?

script.speaker: Caller
script.text: That's right, about two miles west of the centre.

script.speaker: Receptionist
script.text: Great. Could you also give me the postcode for Greenfield?

script.speaker: Caller
script.text: Of course, it's G R four two one.

script.speaker: Receptionist
script.text: Perfect. Now, we offer two types of membership. Standard membership is free, and lets you borrow books. Premium membership costs twenty dollars a year, and also lets you borrow D V Ds.

script.speaker: Caller
script.text: I think Standard will be enough for me, thanks.

script.speaker: Receptionist
script.text: No problem at all. Your card will be ready for collection after three o'clock this afternoon.

script.speaker: Caller
script.text: Wonderful, thank you so much for your help.

script.speaker: Receptionist
script.text: You're very welcome. Have a great day.

prompt.instructions: Tulis nama belakang penelepon persis seperti dieja dalam rekaman.

questions.explanation: Penelepon mengeja namanya: "W, E, B, B" setelah menyebut "Marcus Webb".

prompt.text: What is the caller's street address?

questions.explanation: Penelepon berkata "I live at 42 Elm Street, in Greenfield."

prompt.instructions: Tulis tiga digit angka yang disebutkan.

questions.explanation: Penelepon menyebutkan postcode-nya "G R four two one", yaitu GR421.
Marcus berkata "I think Standard will be enough for me, thanks."

prompt.text: What time can Marcus collect his library card?
prompt.instructions: Tulis jawaban singkat dalam bahasa Inggris.

questions.explanation: Resepsionis berkata kartunya siap diambil "after three o'clock this afternoon."
